blocks:cookie-consent-banner.title: Cookie Consent Banner
blocks:cookie-consent-banner.description: Displays a cookie notification with accept, reject, and customize buttons.

blocks:privacy-policy-summary.title: Privacy Policy Summary
blocks:privacy-policy-summary.description: Simple privacy policy overview card listing key data practices.

blocks:privacy-faq-accordion.title: Privacy FAQ Accordion
blocks:privacy-faq-accordion.description: Expandable privacy FAQ using accordion pattern. Each question reveals a detailed answer on click.

blocks:data-retention.title: Data Retention
blocks:data-retention.description: Table-based data retention schedule showing category, retention period, and legal basis per row.

blocks:data-request-process.title: Data Request Process Timeline
blocks:data-request-process.description: Vertical timeline showing the step-by-step process for handling data requests. Numbered steps with connecting lines guide the user through the workflow.

blocks:regulatory-notice-blocks.title: Regulatory Notice Blocks
blocks:regulatory-notice-blocks.description: Color-coded regulatory notices with info, warning, and critical severity levels. Each notice has a colored left border, icon, and detailed content.

blocks:policy-tabs.title: Policy Tabs
blocks:policy-tabs.description: Multi-section policy card using tabs to switch between data use, security, cookies, and user rights content. Compact way to present multiple policies.

blocks:privacy-rights.title: Privacy Rights
blocks:privacy-rights.description: Two-column comparison table showing data rights and privacy features by plan tier. Badge-styled values for Free vs Pro plans.
